latest_commit.subject: Verification Status report (reqs vs tested vs verified vs version) + spec 2.33
latest_commit.body:
NEW verification/gen_verification_status.py — the owner-asked evidence
report. Scores every requirement into four levels from machine-read
sources only (registry + reports/report.json + testlog/test_runs.db):
NOT TESTED, TESTED (automated CI test = a claim check against the
source), BENCH-TESTED (board-driving tests_mech suite), FIELD-VERIFIED
(a CONCLUDED testlog run cites the ID — real hardware), and stamps each
hardware proof with the firmware version of the run that produced it.
Also emits the locked-but-no-hardware-evidence gap list and a
provenance caveat (a suite=sw report cannot yield BENCH results, so
that 0 is a statement about the run, not the bench suite). Outputs
docs/fluispotter_verification_status.html + reports/
verification_status.json; wired into `make verify` and a standalone
`make verification-status`.

At fw 0.1.161 / DOC 1.102: 176 requirements, 155 tested, 21
FIELD-VERIFIED, 21 untested.

Local site: the report is listed on the Requirements page and its
headline appears on the front-page status card (docs/site/
_refresh_data.py now folds the rollup into _status.json; _build_site.py
renders it and registers the document).

Spec repo 2.33: new §5.6.5 Session Robustness — Bounded Waits,
Deadlines & Entry Ordering (SWR-324/325/326/327), covering the
silent-wedge closure, the field-found loading-deadline anchor defect
(#66) with the "cadence is a test dimension" rule, catch-up policy,
the recovery forfeit trail, and the entry kick-settle (#67, tripwire
armed). Restored the missing TOC entries for 5.6.3/5.6.4/5.6.5. .docx
regenerated; Drive copy updated in place.

make verify: 176 requirements, 153 PASS / 0 FAIL.
